allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

components.description: Array of system components forming the architecture, each with type, responsibilities, and trace links.

items.description: A single architectural component (service, database, queue, etc.) in the system sketch.

component_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this component (e.g., 'comp-auth-service').

type.description: The architectural type of this component: service, db, queue, cache, job, ui, lib, or external.

responsibilities.description: List of 3-6 responsibilities this component handles within the system.

owner.description: Team or domain responsible for this component.

tags.description: Classification tags for this component (e.g., critical-path, stateful, pii).

items.description: A tag classifying the component by criticality, data sensitivity, tenancy, or lifecycle stage.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream capabilities or charter items.

items.description: A traceability reference for this component.

entity_ref.description: Canonical reference to the entity this component represents in the canonical registry.

connections.description: Array of connections between components describing protocols, trust boundaries, and data flow.

items.description: A connection between two components specifying protocol, trust boundary, and optional rate limiting.

from.description: Component ID of the connection source.

to.description: Component ID of the connection destination.

protocol.description: Communication protocol used for this connection: http, grpc, event, rpc, db, or file.

trust_boundary.description: Trust boundary classification: internal (same trust zone), partner (B2B), or public (internet-facing).

schema_ref.description: Reference to the schema governing data exchanged over this connection.

auth.description: Authentication mechanism required for this connection: none, basic, oauth2, jwt, mTLS, or key.

rate_limit.description: Rate limiting configuration for this connection, required for partner/public trust boundaries.

rps.description: Maximum requests per second allowed through this connection.

burst.description: Maximum burst size allowed above the steady-state rate.

window_s.description: Time window in seconds over which the rate limit is measured.

scope.description: Scope at which the rate limit is applied: per-ip, per-client, per-token, or globally.

reliability.description: Message delivery guarantee for event-based connections: best-effort, at-least-once, or exactly-once.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream artifacts for this connection.

items.description: A traceability reference for this connection.

interface_ref.description: Canonical reference to the interface this connection implements.

event_ref.description: Canonical reference to the event type carried by this connection.

connections.description: When 2+ components exist, at least one connection is required.
